mapper.sql: R.RuleNo, R.ShopCode, S.ShopName AS ShopName, IFNULL(R.ChnlCode, '') AS ChnlCode, C.ChnlName AS ChnlName, IFNULL(R.ProdName, '') AS ProdName, IFNULL(R.DealName, '') AS DealName, R.OrderQtyStart, R.OrderQtyEnd, R.OrderAmtStart, R.OrderAmtEnd, R.DeliFee, R.DeliFeeSect, R.PromotFee, R.ChnlFeeRate, R.State, R.Remark, R.RegistId, R.RegistName, CAST(R.RegistDate AS CHAR) AS RegistDate, R.ChangeId, R.ChangeName, CAST(R.ChangeDate AS CHAR) AS ChangeDate
FROM shopwizard.tOrdOrderFeeRule R LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = R.ShopCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl C ON C.ChnlCode = R.ChnlCode

if.test: pRuleNo != null and pRuleNo != '' and pRuleNo.toString().matches('^[0-9]+$')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdOrderFeeRule ( ShopCode, ChnlCode, ProdName, DealName, OrderQtyStart, OrderQtyEnd, OrderAmtStart, OrderAmtEnd, DeliFee, DeliFeeSect, PromotFee, ChnlFeeRate, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{shopCode}, #{chnlCode}, #{prodName}, #{dealName}, #{orderQtyStart}, #{orderQtyEnd}, #{orderAmtStart}, #{orderAmtEnd}, #{deliFee}, #{deliFeeSect}, #{promotFee}, #{chnlFeeRate}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOrdOrderFeeRule SET ShopCode = #{shopCode}, ChnlCode = #{chnlCode}, ProdName = #{prodName}, DealName = #{dealName}, OrderQtyStart = #{orderQtyStart}, OrderQtyEnd = #{orderQtyEnd}, OrderAmtStart = #{orderAmtStart}, OrderAmtEnd = #{orderAmtEnd}, DeliFee = #{deliFee}, DeliFeeSect = #{deliFeeSect}, PromotFee = #{promotFee}, ChnlFeeRate = #{chnlFeeRate}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE RuleNo = #{ruleNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tCmpChnl WHERE ChnlCode = #{chnlCode}
